overview.en:
Read Google Analytics account, property and reporting data through Google’s official local MCP server.

Read Analytics account, property, and report data with a consistent measurement scope. Specify dates and dimensions, then explain how the returned metrics answer the question.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Google 官方本地 MCP 服务读取 Analytics 账号、媒体资源与报表数据。

在一致的统计范围内读取 Analytics 账号、媒体资源和报表数据，指定日期与维度，并解释返回指标如何回答问题。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize traffic sources for this property over the last month.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个媒体资源上个月的流量来源。

starterPrompts.en: Compare these two reporting periods using the same dimensions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 使用相同维度比较这两个报告期。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a report answering this question and explain its metric definitions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备回答这个问题的报表，并解释指标定义。

descriptions.en: Use Google Analytics in Ghast. Read Google Analytics account, property and reporting data through Google’s official local MCP server. 通过 Google 官方本地 MCP 服务读取 Analytics 账号、媒体资源与报表数据。
